name: Brace
desc:
🔧 EARLY DEVELOPMENT WARNING - BUGS ARE COMMON 🔧

Fast paced and chaotic racing game where you drive the track you build!

🏗️BUILD🏗️ --> 🏁RACE🏁 --> 🚧ADD OBSTACLES🚧 --> 🏁RACE🏁 --> 🔁REPEAT🔁

🎮 Default Controls 🎮
WASD - forward/backwards and turning
SHIFT - handbrake / speed up camera (build mode)
E - use powerup
R - rotate build piece
E/Q - camera up/down (build mode)

Inspired by 'Make Way' by Ice BEAM and 'Ultimate Chicken Horse' by Clever Endeavour Games.
